Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::renewBook(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		user: User = User.allInstance()->any(o|o.UserID = uid),
		obs: Set(BookCopy) = BookCopy.allInstance()->select(o|o.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		user.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		obs.isEmpty() = false and
		obs->forAll(o: BookCopy|o.Status = 'AVAILABLE')
	postcondition:
		let renewedLoan: Loan in
		renewedLoan.oclIsNew() and
		user.LoanedBook->includes(renewedLoan) and
		renewedLoan.LoanDate = currentDate and
		renewedLoan.DueDate = renewedLoan.LoanDate+predefinedAmount and
		result = true
}
